title: DeployConfig
description: Per-app, per-environment release values (deploy/<env>.yml). Carries WHAT to run and with which knobs — never resource definitions (those live in <app>-infra) and never deploy logic (that lives in cd-template.yml).

apiVersion.description: Version of the deploy-config contract this file targets. 'cd/v1' today; a breaking format change ships as 'cd/v2' so existing repos keep resolving. An unknown value fails validation.

name.description: App identifier; must match the CI artifact name and the <app>-infra SSM prefix.

target.description: Deploy target — selects the branch of cd-template.yml that runs.

region.description: Optional override of the region in deploy-defaults.yml.

version.description: Immutable artifact ref to deploy: image digest (sha256:...), Lambda zip sha, or static bundle id. Empty is allowed only for env 'dev' (deploys the latest published artifact).

strategy.description: rolling: all targets; blue-green: ecs/ec2 via CodeDeploy; canary: lambda alias shift.

runtime.description: ecs / ec2 / lambda runtime knobs. Ignored for target s3.

cpu.description: ECS task CPU units / Lambda memory hint.

env.description: Non-secret environment variables. Secrets go in `secrets`, never here.

secrets.description: Secret NAMES only — resolved from Secrets Manager / SSM at deploy time by cd-template.yml. Never values.

healthcheck.description: ALB / target-group health check. ecs/ec2 only.

sourceDir.description: Directory inside the build artifact to sync.
